map.：以 A4=440 Hz 为基准，MIDI 音高 n=69+12·log2(f/: : With A4 = 440 Hz as reference, MIDI pitch n = 69 + 12·log2(f/440). f = 440 gives n = 69, that is A4; f = 523.25 gives n about 72, that is C5.
map.十二平均律怎么定义音？: How does 12-tone equal temperament define notes?
map.相邻半音频率比恒为 2^(1/12)≈1.0595，每八度翻倍，A4 约定为 4: The frequency ratio of adjacent semitones is always 2^(1/12), about 1.0595; it doubles every octave, and A4 is conventionally 440 Hz.
map.为什么同一音名有不同频率？: Why does the same note name have different frequencies?
map.取决于基准音高（如 A4=432 Hz 与 440 Hz 体系），本工具默认 4: It depends on the reference pitch (for example the A4 = 432 Hz versus 440 Hz systems); this tool defaults to the 440 Hz international standard.
